body.intent: Fix rhiza change show 01M6WMCCRC0KSCWEV17VY8KVQP fails: 'op 01M6X6KYJY5EPC5BJT5R4EEBB6: op: invalid: field "fields": value of "statement": canon: not canonical', while rhiza check passes and rhiza land succeeded on the same change set (PR #383, merged 9c0d4a2a). Reproduces with main build 6f44a0e5 and later. The op's evidence statement contains '<branch>' text; suspected cause: change show's decode path re-encodes the field with encoding/json default HTML escaping (< > &), so the canonical check fails on text that is canonical on disk. Expect: change show (and every read path) accepts any op that check and land accept.
